subject: Appointments to Multi-Member Bodies
overview: The committee reviewed a revised draft preamble, received updates on public listening sessions and school committee outreach, and debated proposed charter provisions governing appointments and removals for multi-member boards. The committee deferred action on both the preamble and the board appointment proposals to future meetings.

items.title: Preamble Subcommittee Report
items.summary: The committee reviewed a drafted charter preamble and postponed a formal vote to the next meeting to give members time to consider minor wording revisions.

items.title: Listening Sessions Update
items.summary: Jean Zotter reported on completed and upcoming community listening sessions, noting that all sessions are slated to finish by the end of January, and secured volunteer facilitators and note takers.

items.title: Multi-Member Boards Presentation and Discussion
items.summary: The Collins Center and John Moreshi presented proposed charter rules allowing the City Council to reject mayoral appointments or removals by a two-thirds vote and initiate removals unanimously; the proposal was referred back to the subcommittee for revisions amid member pushback regarding volunteer disincentives and mayoral authority.

items.title: School Committee Subcommittee Report
items.summary: Paulette Van der Kloot reported on outreach to school committee members and scheduled an interview with the superintendent, while setting the subcommittee's next meeting for January 11.
